description: This file defines the CustomerAPI class, which provides RESTful endpoints for managing Customer entities within the OrangeHRM Time module. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting customers, along with associated validation rules and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: CustomerAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for Customer entity management, including CRUD operations, search, validation, and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all customers, applies filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new customer.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete multiple customers by IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific customer by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing customer by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'create' method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'delete' method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'update' method.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Returns array of validation rules for the request body when creating or updating a customer.

methods.name: getNameCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates and returns an EntityUniquePropertyOption used to ensure customer name uniqueness.

methods.name: setParamsToCustomer
methods.description: Assigns request parameters to a Customer entity instance.
